consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1994-10-17 show at Madison Square Garden featured a strong performance, particularly highlighted by a lengthy and dynamic 'Eyes of the World' and a memorable encore with Bob Dylan. While some reviewers noted inconsistencies in the second set, many praised the overall energy and emotional depth of the performance.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.2 for 26 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans enjoyed the show and highlighted standout moments, there were notable criticisms regarding the second set's performance and some technical issues, leading to a mixed overall sentiment.
